evidence.source: Owner-authorised Production promotion 190 to 198 on 18 August 2026 from exact repository head 3751dc120a75df8cd9bd1967fc258d6d038f8f2f. Guarded rollout run 32126890172 succeeded after checking for itself that encrypted backup run 32121831688 and fresh exact-head rehearsal run 32126447952 had both concluded success, that the backup preceded the rehearsal, that the backup artifact was present and unexpired, and that the rehearsal head equalled its own. THIS SPAN IS EIGHT MIGRATIONS, NOT ONE, WHICH EVERY EARLIER PRODUCTION SPAN WAS. The boundary was therefore proven as an exact SET rather than a single filename: every migration after 20260814005000 and at or before 20260818030000 was collected, each proven additive by check-migration-additive.mjs, the count required to be exactly eight, and the Supabase dry run diffed against that same collected list so a ninth migration reaching main between rehearsal and rollout would have stopped the apply. ADR 0024 ORDERING WAS ENFORCED FOR THE FIRST TIME ON A PRODUCTION WORKFLOW. Both the rehearsal and the rollout refuse unless the Development record is at or beyond the target, so Production could not be the first hosted environment to see these contracts. Development reached 198 first, through fast-lane run 32119101708. The rehearsal restored a disposable copy from a fresh Production dump, applied exactly the eight, ran all eight behavioural pgTAP suites 239 to 246 against restored Production data, and required every player-facing count to be unchanged before Production was touched. CONFIRMED BY AN INDEPENDENT READ-ONLY QUERY RATHER THAN FROM THE JOB OUTPUT, naming the ledger row: 198 rows with newest 20260818030000 cup_knockout_reservation. EVERYTHING ONLY A HUMAN CAN MOVE IS BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-apply measurement taken the same morning: 1 auth user, 1 profile, 3 entries, 16 season predictions, 36 match predictions, 4 competition entrants, 0 bonus score events, 1 league, 1 league member, 0 Cup launches, 0 Cup fixtures and 578 season fixtures. Euro publication is still hidden, cron holds 11 jobs with an UNCHANGED FINGERPRINT ac9e23f951956da2fba0d8c6f844c14f, and paid collection remains enabled with provider usage at 372. Matchweek scores, provider usage and action items were checked as non-decreasing rather than identical, because Production runs scheduled jobs and demanding equality there would raise a false alarm after the migrations had already landed. CUSTODY VERIFIED ON THE INSTALLED DEFINITIONS. All five new reads - resolve_season_player, get_season_rank_history, get_season_rivalry, get_season_cup_bracket and get_my_football_calendar - are executable by authenticated and by no anonymous role; get_my_football_calendar leaks to no PUBLIC, anon or service_role grantee; and the two action generators and cup_knockout_rounds are executable by NOBODY, with zero grants of any kind. THE IN-PLACE PATCHING ORDER SURVIVED TO THE LIVE DATABASE, all four present at once: contract 102 split-safety and initial-roster pinning, contract 194 eligibility, contract 196 outcome dating on the elimination write, the champion write and the finalise authority, and contract 198 depth authority. process_player_action_items now calls four generators where it called two. THE VERIFICATION WAS KNOWN NON-VACUOUS BEFORE IT RAN. Four of its behavioural assertions were measured FALSE on live Production earlier the same day - contract 194 eligibility absent, contract 198 depth authority absent, two of four generators present rather than four, and zero of the five new reads - so none of them could pass unless the migrations genuinely landed. A fifth assertion was found VACUOUS in that preflight and replaced: it tested for updated_at = now() anywhere in the settle function, a string already present at contract 190, and now tests contract 196 own anchored outcome writes. CONTRACT 198 ANSWERS ON THE LIVE DATABASE: 70 qualifiers need 7 rounds, a hundred entrants over 38 matchweeks reserve exactly those 7, and ten entrants over 38 reserve none. WHAT THIS DID NOT DO. It is schema only. It published no Euro 2028 - the state is still hidden and EURO-001 remains a recorded defect. It launched no competition, drew no Championship and opened no Last Man Standing; Production still holds 0 Cup launches and 0 Cup fixtures. It scheduled no job - the cron fingerprint is unchanged. It imported no football. It did not promote the application, which is separately controlled. THE EDGE FUNCTION WAS NOT TOUCHED by this boundary. edgeFunctionVersion and edgeFunctionBundleSha256 below are CARRIED FORWARD from the contract 190 record and were not re-verified by this rollout.
